what: Mistake: I re-asked the slowest-tests job to read test times from GitHub's CI logs, but the writer works in a sealed snapshot with no GitHub access, so it could not get the data and gave up in seconds
why: I wrote a criterion needing data the producer cannot reach, the same class Athena already records (criteria written without the list of what agents can see); the timings must be supplied in the request or fetched by Athena before dispatch
